say:1:1530112001:0.source_cn: 雅库伯尔需要你！兽群之主！

say:2:1530112002:0.text: The Halians attacked us for no reason. They must be stopped!
say:2:1530112002:0.source_cn: 呼临人无故进犯，不能让他们得逞！
say:2:1530112002:0.male: The Halians attacked us for no reason. They must be stopped!
say:2:1530112002:0.female: The Halians attacked us for no reason. They must be stopped!

say:3:1530112003:0.text: This place can wait. You can always return later.
say:3:1530112003:0.source_cn: 这里，之后再巡视，也可以。
say:3:1530112003:0.male: This place can wait. You can always return later.
say:3:1530112003:0.female: This place can wait. You can always return later.
